body:
> A banner?

I would use banner only for good news, they take too much space for such a "I have a problem" matter (kind of feels like everyone has issues with the doc, which is not the case).

I would put it at the bottom of every webpages. Most probably people will read deeply any webpage to understand that they are missing some information.

So I propose to add "Missing some documentation? [Let us know](LINK TO NEW ISSUE)!" at the end of every page.
